The '''Hoe''' is a tool that can be used to elevate or level the ground. It can also be used to apply the [[Pathen]] and [[Paved road]] ground decorations to an area, visually creating a path for players to walk on.
== Availability ==
It can be crafted in the [[Workbench]].

== How to use==
To more effectively level the ground there are two things to keep in mind. Shift-clicking attaches the hoe to the level of ground it is pointed at. When not shift clicked it defaults the hoe to the level of ground the player is standing on.

Right-clicking opens a menu for other operations, similar to the [[Hammer]]. Some operation have additional requirements, for example raising ground requires 2x[[Stone]] per operation and a [[workbench]] in the players vicinity.

* The Hoe can be upgraded past level 3 at the [[Forge of Potential]] by using a [[Wooden Battle Idol]]. Each upgrade increases its Durability by an additional 200.

== Notes ==
* It can lower the ground but only a little. For the first item available to lower the ground, please see [[Antler Pickaxe]].
*In the "level ground" option the player's position is what the selected terrain is compared to. Therefore, it will raise the selected terrain if the player's position is higher, and lower it, if the player is standing on lower ground. Thus evening out the terrain compared to the player's location.
*Raising and lowering the ground has a maximum allowable amount around 15-20 units based on the mesh shape height established when the world is created. Mesh shape height varies; for example, it may elevate for mountains
*By using the hoe to elevate pillars of earth, players can create much larger stone structures than by building from a flat foundation. Each stone block attached to the earth pillar counts as a new foundation, and is therefore "blue".

{{infobox weapon | title = Cultivator | image = Cultivator.png | description = A farming tool for tilling soil. | id = Cultivator | type = Tool | source = [[Forge]] | usage = Farming | wielding = Two-handed | weight = 2.0 | durability = 200 | crafting level = 1 | repair level = 1 | materials 1 = * [[Corewood]] x5 * [[Bronze]] x5 | materials 2 = * [[Corewood]] x1 * [[Bronze]] x1 | materials 3 = * [[Corewood]] x2 * [[Bronze]] x2 | idol = * [[Wooden Battle Idol]] | durability per level = 200}} The '''Cultivator''' can be used on a patch of land to ready it for planting seeds, as well as to plant trees. With the ''Grass'' mode, the player can regrow grass on patches of dirt, regrow lily pads on water, create sand on the shoreline and regrow cattails in certain areas around the shore. Use of Cultivator does use stamina, making Hildir's clothing useful for managing large farms. == Availability == Made at a [[Forge]]. It becomes available to craft once the player has obtained [[Bronze]] and [[Corewood]]. == Usage == The Cultivator is a farming tool for tilling soil, planting seeds, and restoring damaged environments. Crops will display a status next to their name when planted until they are fully grown. The ''"Healthy"'' status means the plant is growing. All food crops need cultivated soil. Crops will not grow if any of the three conditions are met: * Wrong biome * Not enough space * Not enough sunlight Some crops can only be planted in certain biome requirements. Planting a crop in the wrong environment will display the ''"Can't grow in this environment"'' status. Most crops require a 1x1 area of free space around them. Other crops, structures, or objects placed within this space will prevent the plant from growing. This is true even for rocks that have been covered by the terrain. Any objects within this free space will cause the "''Needs more room to grow"'' status. Crops require unobstructed view of the sky. Any structures built over a crop will cause the ''"Needs an open sky"'' status, regardless of how high the structure is above the crop. Unique among crops - Vineberry vines need to be 1 away from a flat built wall to climb. It can cross over Window or door openings, but any overhang or break in the wall will stop its growth. Fences and decorative panels count as walls for purpose of trellising. Vineberries needs a greater spacing between plants. Trees are also planted with a Cultivator.
